subject: general
question:
The following chart represents the demand and production of five companies V, W, X, Y and Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ae0683befbb545289880f7cead9322a37fb8c1dd2601de7a51ad061d4100973.png] 

If K% of the production of company W equals the production of company Z, then K equals:
solution:
**Calculation:**

K % × production of company W = production of company Z

⇒ K% × 1600 = 2400

⇒ K × 16 = 2400

⇒ K = 2400/16 = 150

**∴ The correct answer is 150.**
